latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Miniature World Generator.

- Generate AI-powered miniature world and diorama art using the Neta AI image generation API.
- Supports tilt-shift, tiny world, hyper-detailed diorama, and fantasy landscape styles.
- Customize output with options for image size and style reference.
- Easy command-line usage and quick start instructions included.
- Requires a free Neta API token for image generation.
